actual: Load ~3: 0 remotes 10.7 fps (p95 133 ms), 55 remotes 13.8/13.5 fps. Load ~1.5: 0 remotes 27.8 fps (p95 50), 55 remotes 24.3/23.5 fps (p95 50 ms, 36-63 long tasks/8 s, max 59 ms).
